</a>

            </h1>

            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>一、设计思路</h1>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>表格</div>
<br>
<div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>


</div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>特性</th><th>作用</th><th>实现方式</th></tr>


</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>限流</td>
<td>防止接口被刷、防止流量洪峰</td>
<td>令牌桶 / 滑动窗口 + Redis / 内存缓存</td>


</tr>
<tr>
<td>防重</td>
<td>防止前端重复点击 / 网络重试重复提交</td>
<td>请求唯一 ID + 短时间锁</td>


</tr>
<tr>
<td>幂等性</td>
<td>保证接口重复调用结果一致</td>
<td>唯一业务键 + 状态机 + 分布式锁</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>


</div>


</div>


</div>


</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<hr>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h1>二、.NET 完整实现代码</h1>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h2>1. 依赖安装</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>Install-Package AspNetCoreRateLimit # 限流
Install-Package StackExchange.Redis # Redis
Install-Package MediatR # 可选
Install-Package Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.StackExchangeRedis
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h1>2. 接口限流</h1>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>使用 AspNetCoreRateLimit，支持 IP 限流、客户端限流。</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h2>appsettings.json</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>"IpRateLimiting": {
  "EnableEndpointRateLimiting": true,
  "StackBlockedRequests": false,
  "HttpStatusCode": 429,
  "GeneralRules": [
    {
      "Endpoint": "*",
      "Period": "1s",
      "Limit": 10  // 每秒最多 10 次
    },
    {
      "Endpoint": "POST:/api/order",
      "Period": "1s",
      "Limit": 2   // 订单接口每秒最多 2 次
    }
  ]
}
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<h2>Program.cs 注册</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();
builder.Services.AddInMemoryRateLimiting();
builder.Services.AddSingleton&lt;IRateLimitConfiguration, RateLimitConfiguration&gt;();

app.UseIpRateLimiting(); // 必须放在路由之前
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>限流返回：429 Too Many Requests</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<hr>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h1>3. 防重复提交</h1>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>核心：请求唯一 ID（RequestId）+ 短时间锁
<div>&nbsp;</div>
前端提交时携带 <code>Request-Id</code> 头，后端校验是否重复。</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h2>防重过滤器 / 中间件</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 防重复提交特性
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method)]
public class IdempotentAttribute : Attribute
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 锁过期时间（秒）
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public int ExpireSeconds { get; set; } = 5;
}
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<h2>防重过滤器</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>public class IdempotentFilter : IAsyncActionFilter
{
    private readonly IDistributedCache _cache;

    public IdempotentFilter(IDistributedCache cache)
    {
        _cache = cache;
    }

    public async Task OnActionExecutionAsync(ActionExecutingContext context, ActionExecutionDelegate next)
    {
        // 只拦截 POST/PUT/DELETE
        var method = context.HttpContext.Request.Method;
        if (method is "GET" or "HEAD")
        {
            await next();
            return;
        }

        // 获取请求唯一 ID（前端传入 Header）
        if (!context.HttpContext.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("Request-Id", out var requestId))
        {
            context.Result = new JsonResult(new { code = 400, msg = "缺少 Request-Id" });
            return;
        }

        var attr = context.ActionDescriptor.EndpointMetadata
            .OfType&lt;IdempotentAttribute&gt;()
            .FirstOrDefault();

        var key = $"req:lock:{requestId}";

        // 已存在 = 重复提交
        var exists = await _cache.GetStringAsync(key);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(exists))
        {
            context.Result = new JsonResult(new { code = 429, msg = "请勿重复提交" });
            return;
        }

        // 加锁
        await _cache.SetStringAsync(key, "1", new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
        {
            AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(attr?.ExpireSeconds ?? 5)
        });

        await next();
    }
}
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<h2>注册</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>builder.Services.AddScoped&lt;IdempotentFilter&gt;();
builder.Services.AddDistributedRedisCache(options =&gt;
{
    options.Configuration = "localhost:6379";
});

builder.Services.AddControllers(o =&gt;
{
    o.Filters.Add&lt;IdempotentFilter&gt;();
});
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<h2>使用</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>[HttpPost("order")]
[Idempotent(ExpireSeconds = 10)] // 10 秒内防重
public async Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; CreateOrder(OrderDto dto)
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h1>4. 幂等性设计</h1>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h2>幂等性定义</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>同一个请求执行 1 次和执行 N 次，结果完全一样，不会产生脏数据。</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>适用场景：</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<ul>
<li>支付</li>
<li>订单创建</li>
<li>退款</li>
<li>表单提交</li>
<li>回调接口</li>
</ul>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h2>实现方案</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h3>步骤</h3>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<ol>
<li>前端获取 token（幂等号）</li>
<li>提交时携带 token</li>
<li>后端使用 分布式锁 + 状态机 保证只执行一次</li>
</ol>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h3>代码实现</h3>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h2>1）获取幂等 Token</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>[HttpGet("token")]
public async Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; GetIdempotentToken()
{
    var token = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
    await _cache.SetStringAsync($"idt:{token}", "ok", TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10));
    return Ok(new { token });
}
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<h2>2）幂等接口</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre><code>[HttpPost("pay")]
public async Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; Pay(PayRequest dto)
{
    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dto.IdempotentToken))
        return BadRequest("缺少幂等Token");

    var lockKey = $"lock:pay:{dto.IdempotentToken}";

    // 分布式锁（只有一个请求能进入）
    var lockTaken = await _cache.GetStringAsync(lockKey);
    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(lockTaken))
        return Ok(new { code = 200, msg = "已支付，请勿重复提交" });

    await _cache.SetStringAsync(lockKey, "1", TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));

    try
    {
        // 1. 查询订单是否已处理
        var order = await _db.Orders.FirstOrDefaultAsync(o =&gt; o.OrderNo == dto.OrderNo);
        if (order?.Status == PayStatus.Success)
            return Ok(new { code = 200, msg = "成功" });

        // 2. 执行业务
        await DoPay(dto);

        // 3. 更新状态（关键！）
        order.Status = PayStatus.Success;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return Ok(new { code = 200, msg = "支付成功" });
    }
    catch
    {
        // 失败释放锁，允许重试
        await _cache.RemoveAsync(lockKey);
        throw;
    }
}
</code></pre>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h1>三、三者区别</h1>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>
<div>表格</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>名称</th><th>目的</th><th>范围</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>限流</td>
<td>保护服务器不被打垮</td>
<td>频率控制</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>防重</td>
<td>防止短时间重复点击</td>
<td>请求唯一 ID</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>幂等性</td>
<td>保证多次调用结果一致</td>
<td>业务唯一键</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<hr>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h1>四、实践</h1>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<ol>
<li>防重 + 幂等一起用
<ul>
<li>防重：前端快速重复点击</li>
<li>幂等：网络重试、回调重试、消息重试</li>
</ul>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</li>
<li>限流放在网关层最好（Kong / YARP）</li>
<li>幂等必须依赖数据库状态
<div>&nbsp;</div>
不能只靠缓存，缓存丢了会出问题</li>
<li>POST/PUT/DELETE 必须幂等</li>
<li>防重时间 5～10 秒，幂等时间 5～30 分钟</li>
</ol>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<hr>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h3>总结</h3>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<ul>
<li>限流：保护服务，控制请求频率</li>
<li>防重：防止重复提交，依赖 RequestId</li>
<li>幂等性：保证结果一致，依赖 Token + 状态机</li>
<li>三者组合使用，是企业级 API 安全标准方案</li>
</ul>

</div>
